### Ballina Punx Xmas Gig

![Ballina Punx](news/punx-xmas.jpg)

TheNCF is hosting for the first time the annual Ballina Punx Xmas Gig. The Ballina Punx are a really valuable group in our community and we couldn't be happier to start our hopefully long-lasting series of gigs with this one.

### Event Details
- **Date:** Saturday 28th December 2024
- **Time:** 8pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, F26 C925
- **Admission:** €10 at the door
